notes: Windows: every php.net zip from 4.4.0 to 8.5.x was grouped by toolchain; per minor line the first, middle and last zips (plus bisection where they differed) were downloaded and every PE inside read (subsystem version + imports vs the Windows version that introduced each API). min_os is set by the core files (php.exe, php-cgi.exe, php-win.exe, phpN[ts].dll); where an optional extension or bundled library needs more, the rule's notes say so. Linux/macOS: php.net ships no binaries; rules cover static-php-cli 'common' builds, every macOS file read, Linux first/middle/last per minor. Scratch tooling: binscan.py/aggscan.py in the researcher's scratchpad (not kept in the repo).
